name: Full-plate
text:
*Armour (4+)*

Fighters equipped with this armour cannot be equipped with two-handed ranged weapons with the exception of a Brace of Pistols.

name: Heavy Plating
text:
*Armour (5+)*

Subtract 1 from the Move value of fighters equipped with this armour.

name: Warded Robes
text:
*Armour (6+)*

Roll a dice each time a fighter equipped with this armour is targeted by a spell cast by an enemy fighter. On a 4+, the spell has no effect on this fighter.

name: Bomb Rat
text:
*Item, Rare 0-1*

Once per battle, while this fighter is not engaged in melee, they can make the following bonus action:

**Set Up Bomb Rat [Bonus Action]:** A Giant Rat is summoned and added to the commanding player's warband. Set up the Giant Rat fighter within 3" of the fighter and choose a number between 1 and 6. This number is the **fuse length**. Use a dice placed next to the Giant Rat to track the fuse length.

Each time that Giant Rat activates, roll a dice. If the roll is greater than the fuse length, the bomb detonates. If the roll is equal or less than than the fuse length, the Giant Rat is activated as normal and the fuse length is reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 1).

When the bomb detonates, the blast template is centred on the Giant Rat. Each other fighter in the template it is hit with the following attack (Rend -2, Damage d3), then the Giant Rat is taken down (it does not count towards flee tests).

If the Giant Rat is taken down and the bomb has not yet detonated, roll a dice as above to see if it detonates or not.

name: Clan Banner
text:
*Held Item, Rare: 0-1*

While this fighter is on the battlefield, you can re-roll flee tests.

You can re-roll Willpower tests made by friendly fighters while they are within 12" of this fighter and this fighter is visible to them.

name: Ensorcelled Bell
text:
*Item, Rare: 0-1*

Once per battle, you can re-roll a **miscast roll** made for this fighter.

name: Grappling Hook
text:
*Item, Rare: 0-2*

This fighter can climb high walls in the same manner as ladders.

name: Grimoire
text:
*Item, Rare: 0-1*

Once per battle, after this fighter has made casting roll, you can re-roll the casting roll.

name: Net
text:
*Held Item, Rare: 0-3*

Once per battle, at the start of a melee attack action in which this fighter is either the attacking or defending fighter, they can throw the net. To do so, they take an Initiative test. If passed, the enemy fighter becomes *entwined*.

While a fighter is entwined, subtract 1 from the Attacks value of their melee weapons (off-hand attacks are unaffected). Each time an entwined fighter is activated, they can take an Initiative test, if passed, they are no longer entwined.

name: Periscope
text:
*Item, Rare: 0-1*

While this fighter hasn't made a move in the same activation, add 5" to the Range value of their two-handed ranged weapons (excluding those with the *Flame* weapon trait).

name: Shield
text:
*Held Item*

Improve this fighter's Armour value by 1, to a maximum of 2+. (For example, 6+ becomes 5+).

name: Smoke Bomb
text:
*Item, Rare: 0-3*

Once per battle, while this fighter is engaged in melee, they can use the following bonus action:

**Drop Smoke Bomb [Bonus Action]:** Remove this fighter from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 6" of its previous position and not engaged in melee.

name: Wheel-Spikes
text:
*Item*

Improve the Rend value by 1 on this fighter's Crushing Bulk melee weapon and the attack dealt by the 'Splat!' special rule.
